Leadership visit
From November 3 to November 6, we embarked on a remarkable week dedicated to learning, growth, and meaningful connection. Curated training sessions sparked meaningful discussions and equipped participants with practical strategies for giving and receiving feedback, strengthening stakeholder relationships, and writing with impact. Lesli Hamilton, Annabell Lepe, Kandace Gallant, Vineet Arora, Rajat Mishra, and Ripunjay (RJ) Nandikonda facilitated workshops on
‘Culture of Feedback,’ ‘Master Delivery,’
and
‘Smart Brevity.’
These sessions provided attendees with valuable and actionable insights to elevate their impact and drive success together.

Behind-the-scenes!
Latest creative moves, big ideas, and tiny tweaks
Crafting proposals is an art that we are transforming into science. We don’t just follow best practices; we invent them to make the proposal creation journey smarter, more efficient, and dare we say…fun.
From small but mighty fixes to fresh design hacks, we have been tackling those little ‘proposal quirks’ one by one. Here, we dish out the secret sauce behind turning ‘good’ into ‘marvelous’—from clever content tips, and design tricks to workflow improvement that make our work shine. Think of it as our very own lab where we’re brewing up solutions for every little proposal pickle that pops up. So, buckle in, grab your imagination hats, and get ready to see how we’re making proposals sparkle one genius tweak at a time!
